about_the_game:
Man, just committed his new greatest sin, trying to overcome death with a vaccine. This divine disobedience is threatening to wipe out humanity. The only way to stop our second punishment is to uncover the truth. You will play as survivalist Austin Watts who has gotten trapped at an abandoned summer camp deep in the mountains. After establishing contact with a rescue team, you will learn you have only seven days to uncover a mystery you know nothing about.

As you search for clues scattered across the campgrounds, you must use a handheld radio to communicate with your brother along with scattered survivors, gather supplies, and fight to survive against the infected that roam the forest. Every night grows darker, and every discovery brings you closer to the horrifying truth behind humanity’s downfall.

You will explore a desolate camp, use your instincts to piece together evidence, connect the dots, and uncover the story of what really happened at Camp Hope.

Key features

  • Seven-day campaign.

  • Scavenging and crafting system.

  • Radio communication that reveals key aspects of the game.

  • Lots of evidence to discover with varying levels of usefulness.

  • Dynamic day/night cycle where threats, visibility, and infected behavior shift.

  • Environmental storytelling: logs, photos, recordings, and clues to reconstruct the truth.

  • Tactical survival combat: improvised weapons, stealth, and resource management.

  • Atmospheric sound design and layered environment to turn a familiar camp space into a dead ruin.

  • More lore to the overarching story than what meets the eye.

Inspired by the biblical tale of the separation of man and God.

name: Revenant
short_description: Created by a 16 year old game developer, Revenant has you trapped in Camp Hope, you have 7 days to uncover its dark secrets while avoiding the infected. Every night brings new threat, and every discovery brings you closer to the truth behind the second fall of man.
